name: HRConvert2
tagline: HRConvert2 is a self-hosted drag-and-drop file conversion server & file sharing tool that supports 86 file formats with 4 color schemes & 13 end-user selctable languages.
description: HRConvert2 is a self-hosted drag-and-drop file conversion server & file sharing tool that supports 86 file formats with 4 color schemes & 13 end-user selctable languages.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: dwaaan/hrconvert2-docker:latest
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
